claim_as_published: The dashboard treats 境内个人 as two different things in two places (SAFE one continuous year; IIT 183 days).

note: Two official instruments, two tests, both in force: one continuous year for FX purposes, 183 days for tax residence. Neither is wrong; they answer different questions.
